replies.text:
Check (step 2):
- Automated abuse of a reachable endpoint: design has "Logistics partners call POST /shipments with an API key to create shipments" and "Shipments are billed to the merchant automatically" — covered by listed threat 3 (bulk shipment creation) and 2 (leaked key).
- Staff/admin/moderator screens showing partner-supplied content: design names no internal console, queue or review screen — no such thing in this design.
- Delete/moderate/refund/approve/role-change/money move without a record of who did it: design has "Shipments are billed to the merchant automatically" with multiple partners per merchant — covered by listed threat 5 (repudiation of which partner created the charge).
- Personal/financial documents or pages a browser, proxy or CDN could cache: design describes only a POST create call, no document or page delivery — no such thing in this design.
- Attacker-controlled text reaching logs, CSV/spreadsheet exports, emails, headers or another system: design mentions only "The request names the merchantId to bill and the declared value" with no export, notification or downstream rendering named — no such thing stated.
- Single-reviewer item (replay / duplicate billing): the design states no idempotency, retry or duplicate behaviour at all; the claim rests on how the endpoint would be built, and its harm (extra billable shipments charged to the merchant) is the same as listed threat 3 — not a gap.
